name: Sunniva
title: Keeper of the Pine and Bell
examine: She banks the fire at midnight and builds it again at half three, because the watch comes off the tower at four and has to go somewhere.
lines: Sit anywhere. The corner by the fire is Torvi's and she will tell you so herself.
Four in the morning is my busiest hour. You get used to it or you get out of the trade.
The bell in my sign is the tower's bell. My grandfather thought that was funny.
